# spaceman watch

Follow the change feed: one line per change you may see, until interrupted.

Streams GET /api/v1/watch (Server-Sent Events). Each change names a resource and its new version, never its content; read the object with its get command. -o json prints JSON Lines. A gap (retention pruned changes after --after) is reported on standard error; re-list what you follow.

```sh
spaceman watch [flags]
```

Raw route: `GET /watch` (outside the OpenAPI document, same authentication; see the [HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman watch --after 1200 -o json | jq -c 'select(.resource_type == "task")'
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--after` | integer |  | start after this change sequence (0: from the oldest retained change) |
| `--count` | integer |  | stop after this many changes (0: follow until interrupted) |
